name: Shanghai Rychen Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Rychen Technologies Co., Ltd. operates in the general equipment manufacturing industry in China. The company offers centrifugal fans and water pumps, energy-saving centrifugal pumps, plate preheaters, low-nitrogen burners, permanent magnet motors and other energy products. The company's products are widely used in high-energy-consuming industries, including steel, cement, non-ferrous metals, chemicals, mining, and building materials, supporting fluid transport, cooling, dust removal, heating, sewage treatment, and thermal power generation industries. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Shanghai, China.
